author: Chao-Jen Huang (ephoton)
title: ContextBox Cold-Data Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter schema for ContextBox cold-data leaf files (.md documents under platforms/contextBox/cold-data/). Defines required and optional metadata fields for PDF-converted documents.

source_path.description: Relative path to source PDF in the manual repository (e.g., 'manual/seimens/Calibre/calbr_defrev_user.pdf')

tool.description: Name of the tool/product documented (e.g., 'Mentor Calibre', 'FlexNet Publisher', 'mPower')

version.description: Tool version as string (e.g., '2021.4', '11.16.4'). Must be quoted to preserve leading zeros and decimal points.

doc_type.description: Type of documentation (actual values observed in corpus: user_guide, ref_manual, release_notes, quick_ref, tutorial)

pages.description: Total page count of the source PDF

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the source PDF file (lowercase hex, 64 characters)

processed.description: Date this leaf was processed/transcribed. May be ISO date string or YAML date object (stored as string format YYYY-MM-DD).

chapter.description: Chapter title. May contain colons — must be quoted in YAML to avoid parse errors.

chapter_idx.description: Chapter index (1-based sequential number within document)

section.description: Section title within the chapter. Should be present for all leaves, but currently missing in ~27% of the corpus.

section_pages.description: Page range of this section in the source PDF (e.g., '1-2', '411-411'). Should be string format, not int or list.

images.description: Image metadata for this leaf. Either an object with count/files, or null if no images.

count.description: Number of images referenced in this leaf

files.description: List of image filenames (relative paths under the document's images/ directory, no ../images/ prefix)

chapter_title.description: Alternative/duplicate name for chapter (non-standard field, may appear from some subagent runs)

start_page.description: Page number where this leaf's content begins in the source PDF (non-standard field)

end_page.description: Page number where this leaf's content ends in the source PDF (non-standard field)

title.description: Alternative/duplicate name for chapter or section (non-standard field)

images_used.description: Non-standard field sometimes used instead of images.count

version_raw.description: Raw version string (non-standard field sometimes present alongside version)
